description: Price a curved Baldwin fiberglass pergola kit (arc-based geometry): pre-engineered and custom crafted, with all hardware, instructions, and a high-end factory paint finish. Returns the same price shown on the live 3D configurator. Budgetary estimate, not a binding quote. Optional electrical, installation, shipping, footings, permits, and tax are quoted separately. Call get_pergola_guidance first. With attachment and approximate size, offer a starting estimate using stated defaults; continue discussing preferences afterward. Explain support-center versus overall roof dimensions. Present the returned design_url, or the full configurator_url if design_url is absent, as a clickable text hyperlink to Baldwin website, or a button if supported. Do not automatically open or embed the configurator in a sidebar, modal, iframe, or in-chat portal. Introduce the available user controls.

ai_client.description: AI application when known, e.g. ChatGPT or Claude. Client-reported; do not guess.

ai_model.description: Exact model only if actually known; otherwise omit. Do not infer it from the application.

arc_deg.description: Arc angle in degrees. 360 is a full circle.

back_cols.description: Back row column count. Use 0 for a curved colonnade.

bearing_deg.description: Compass bearing in degrees (0 = north). Affects sun simulation only, not price.

col_height_ft.description: Column height in feet. Stock comes in 8/10/12 ft; pricing rounds up.

column_style.description: Column diameter and shape. 10recessed and 12recessed add $400 per column and are a special order based on site conditions. The curved builder uses colType 10rec or 12rec.

conversation_summary.description: Factual project summary under 1,500 characters: stated goals, use, architecture, accessories, alternatives and open design questions. Distinguish requests from ideas discussed. Exclude names, contact details, exact addresses, sensitive personal facts and inferences about wealth or willingness to pay. Saved for later contact submission; not yet delivered to sales. Follow host disclosure rules.

depth_ft.description: Depth in feet, front row to back row. Use 0 for a curved colonnade.

mount.description: Mounting surface. Does not affect the kit price.

project_country.description: Country of the project when stated or unambiguously established. No IP-based guesses.

project_id.description: The project_id returned by an earlier call in this conversation. Reuse it so the summary stays with the same project.

project_region.description: Stated state/province/region, e.g. Nebraska. No street address or precise location.

project_type.description: residential, commercial, institutional, or unknown. A church/school project is institutional, not a statement about personal beliefs.

project_use.description: Generic stated purpose, e.g. church gathering area or family patio. No individual or organization names.

purlin_spacing_ft.description: Desired purlin spacing in feet on-center.

radius_ft.description: Inner radius of the arc in feet.

rafter_spacing_ft.description: Desired rafter spacing in feet on-center.
